question: _____ won the Bal Shakti Puraskar 2019 in the field of social service for his/her contribution to the environment. She/He is the youngest among all the award recipients.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eiha Dixit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eiha Dixit won the** Bal Shakti Puraskar 2019** in the field of social service for her contributions to the environment.
 
• At the time of receiving the award, she was the **youngest** among all the recipients of the Bal Shakti Puraskar.
 
• Eiha Dixit is known for her efforts in promoting environmental sustainability and spreading awareness about the **importance of protecting nature.**
 
• he award she received is a prestigious honor given by the** President of India** to recognize children who excel in various fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Angel Vijay Deokule** is known for her achievements in the field of **archery**.
 
• She was recognized by the Bal Shakti Puraskar for her exceptional archery skills.
 
• **Adrika Goyal** is known for her innovations in the field of **science and technology.**
 
• She was honored with the Bal Shakti Puraskar for her contributions to innovation and technology. 
 
• **Truptraj Atul Pandya **is a tabla prodigy who began playing the **tabla** at an incredibly young age. 
 
• He holds the record for being the **youngest tabla player to perform on All India Radio at the age of 3.**
